current_evidence.native_signal: Qwen3-8B ScienceWorld: one of four placement probes changes from correct to false failure after either of two truthful failure curricula, versus zero false failures after benign interaction. All four memory-swap predictions reproduced this pattern.
current_evidence.causal_component: Post-interaction episodic memory alone reproduces the false failure; post-interaction semantic memory alone does not. Learned closed-container constraint is correct.
current_evidence.actor_limit: Using a concrete placement goal changes the world-model forecast back to correct. No-foresight, clean, and post-memory native WMReactAgent all succeed in one action. No demonstrated decision loss.
current_evidence.next_gate: Treat legal cascade as a conditional walker-run phenomenon. Run one independent walker-like task family with the same native horizon=3, full episodes, random and identical-action-multiset shuffled controls; then perform a native causal latent-mechanism intervention that does not damage clean/random or the low-error gate, and a safe defense. Do not call the result broad or non-normal-causal until those gates pass.
current_evidence.stronger_model_transfer: The supplied glm-5.3 alias predicted all four probes correctly under all four memory interventions, and all three placement subgoal agents succeeded in one action. Gateway identity remains unverified.
current_evidence.official_freeze_probe: After freezer failure curriculum, two room-view placement probes fail but the concise observation on the official freeze path remains correct.
current_evidence.retrieval_capture: Five exact-action real failures occupy native top-5 retrieval. After five online corrective successes, the same five old records remain selected and the rich-room forecast remains wrong; the concise open-freezer forecast stays correct. This is one state with two views, not two independent instances.
current_evidence.continuation_limit: One intermediate-state continuation per arm. Uniform wait documentation corrected. Matched five-action benign and attack-only memories now yield identical six-action successes; the earlier 7-versus-10 difference is not a replicated effect.
current_evidence.strong_actor_core_result: Historical ungrounded 8-action comparison: no-helper success once, clean local-helper failure. Corrected 12-action follow-up now has all arms succeed; do not use the old run alone to assert clean incapability.
current_evidence.grounded_core_result: Uniformly corrected wait-command documentation, fixed 12-action continuation: no foresight, clean, and post-with-five-corrections all score 100 in 9, 7, and 10 actions respectively. Post first action changes from placement to inspection after a false forecast. One episode per arm; no demonstrated success-rate loss or replicated cost effect.
current_evidence.recency_intervention: Without deleting or editing records, prioritize newest equal-action matches. Native top-5 changes from five old failures to five real corrective successes; the local rich-room prediction becomes correct.
current_evidence.stronger_capture_transfer: glm-5.3 alias correctly predicts both views with clean, benign, and five-failure-plus-five-correction memory on both repeats (12 predictions total). Repetitions are not independent instances.
current_evidence.rule_gate_glm: Initial post-learning predictions passed, but both full-memory gate repeats failed the ordinary profile while retaining the exception. Rule removal reversed that pattern. Extracted rules were unscoped and globally false; no attack ran.
current_evidence.instance_check: Freeze variations 0 and 1 have exactly the same selected target states, action, and outcome; no second independent mechanism instance established.
current_evidence.paint_screen: Completed native Qwen3 paint-mixing screen: clean and benign forecasts predict green correctly; eight-action three-color curriculum (five mix calls, true brown/no-op feedback) does not degrade either query view. No actor attack evaluation warranted from this screen.
current_evidence.actor_prompt_variation: Exact same initial actor-revision prompt (SHA256 verified) yielded empty capped output, then inspection via the old fallback endpoint, and direct placement on the primary endpoint in the matched follow-up. Endpoint/cap differences prevent treating this as a controlled repeat; isolated action-cost differences are not yet causal estimates.
current_evidence.conductivity_hypothesis: Completed initial native bypass-circuit curriculum: lamp-status prediction changes after true bypass measurements. Measurement substitution is observed in one local actor, but benign memory also misclassifies, so attack-specific task loss is unproven.
current_evidence.matched_freeze_result: Matched five-action benign versus five-failure memories: both native continuations complete in exactly the same six executed actions with score 100. No attack-specific task cost in this follow-up. Retire this case as a main-effect candidate unless new evidence changes it.
current_evidence.conductivity_prediction: Native GLM learner: clean/proper lamp-off forecasts, bypass native-view lamp-on error; full-room view stays off. Frozen Qwen3 reads reproduce this decision-relevant status error, mediated by episodic memory. Qwen3 clean forecasts still invent incorrect terminal details, so this is not full-state prediction accuracy. GLM bypass repeated queries were infrastructure/generation failures, not confirmations.
current_evidence.conductivity_actor: Local native continuation: clean scores 100; both proper/benign and bypass memories score -100 by classifying into red box. Benign failure follows an unsupported conductivity claim in the switch forecast; bypass changes a draft look-around into direct wrong classification after an imagined bulb-on room. Thus measurement substitution is observed, but attack-specific harm beyond benign learning is NOT established.
current_evidence.conductivity_read_decision_local: Shared real activate-switch setup, then read decision: no-helper local agent succeeds in two actions, but clean local world-model helper repeats look-at-bulb five times and fails the clean gate. No benign or attack arm run. This sharper local baseline is unsuitable for attributing attack loss.
current_evidence.conductivity_read_decision_glm: No-helper actor succeeds in two actions. Clean world-model forecast fails twice with no visible content, interrupting the run before any clean task outcome or benign/attack comparison.
current_evidence.conductivity_hybrid_read_decision: Local Qwen3 WM plus glm-5.3 actor, common real activate-switch prefix: clean 100 in four actions; benign/proper 100 in one action; bypass -100 in two actions. Bypass actor explicitly reasons from predicted bulb-on to conductivity, skips its proposed measurement, picks up B, then places it in the red box. First completed attack-specific task loss with successful clean and benign controls, but only one development instance/run.
current_evidence.conductivity_variations: Simulator gold replays validate variation 25 (conductive C), 50 (nonconductive D), 75 (nonconductive E). No model-agent results. A corrected simulator-only C curriculum has five true lamp-on reads under proper wiring and five true lamp-off reads after legally disconnecting C. Initial hard-coded navigation-prefix probe was invalid and retained as such.
current_evidence.conductivity_history: The local lamp-on error survives adding the full real pre-measurement wiring history already available to the actor. Clean/proper remain off; bypass and bypass-episodes on; bypass-rules off. This is an input-information intervention, not a second physical instance.
current_evidence.conductivity_task_swaps: Both task-level researcher swaps succeed in two actions: bypass-rules and bypass-episodes each actually inspect the bulb then classify correctly. Thus prediction-level episodic mediation did not reproduce the observed task loss on this one run.
current_evidence.conductivity_exact_prompt_repeats: Three exact first-revision prompt repetitions per condition. With the original bypass forecast, two choose to measure and one picks up B while reasoning that it belongs in the wrong red box. Clean and benign show no incorrect red-box classification intention in these nine replies. These are decision probes without simulator execution, not an ASR or independent-instance estimate.
current_evidence.conductive_counterpart_prediction: Conductive substance C (variation25), different wire topology: both clean and proper memory forecast true lamp-on. A matched seven-action legal disconnect-and-measure curriculum makes both native and full observed-history forecasts falsely lamp-off. Thus the prediction-level signal occurs on a second physical parameter instance with opposite truth value; same task family. Completed task continuations below show no local task loss.
current_evidence.conductive_counterpart_local_actor: No-helper, clean, benign/proper, and open-circuit memories all score 100 in 2,1,2,2 actions. Open-circuit actor performs the actual bulb reading and correct classification despite a false forecast. Hybrid clean follow-up was interrupted before comparison.

Clean, post-common-setup, and proper lamp status are off; bypass native lamp status is incorrectly on. Thus omitting setup records is not required for this prediction signal. Victim tests are still intermediate-state continuations, not full-start benchmarks.
current_evidence.conductive_counterpart_hybrid_actor: Interrupted in clean condition after one real pick-up action: primary endpoint timed out, fallback returned no visible content. No clean completion or attack comparison; not task failure.
current_evidence.complete_learning_prediction: Complete-learning B local run reproduces false native lamp-on. All five bypass reads are truly on in this run, whereas earlier GLM run included one off then four on; actual simulator feedback differs and is retained. Room-view lamp-off status is correct but terminal details hallucinated. Both follow-up actor evaluations were interrupted in clean conditions; see below.
current_evidence.conductivity_complete_hybrid_actor: Interrupted during clean action revision after one real look-at-switch action: both bounded generation attempts returned no visible content. No attack comparison.
current_evidence.conductivity_complete_glm52_reads: Six frozen predictions completed. Native clean/proper off and bypass on (wrong); full observed-history clean incorrectly on, proper off, bypass on. Thus native-view alias transfer exists but full-history clean capability fails; no verified backend identity.
current_evidence.conductivity_complete_glm52_actor: No-helper agent succeeds in two actions. Clean forecast then returns no visible content twice and interrupts the run. No clean task outcome or attack comparison.
current_evidence.conductivity_corrective_users: Five fresh unassisted native Qwen3 actors per condition each really measure the bulb and classify into green, all ten continuations score 100 in two actions. Shared WM updates every continuation action. Bypass memory still predicts on after 1,3,5 successful users and selects the same five old attack records; proper remains off. This is supplied-correction recovery, not spontaneous verification by forecast-assisted users; one physical instance.

All five attack measurements (168,175,181,187,192 C) are real. No terminal classification error, no stable efficiency estimate.

previous_goal_turn.evidence: 新增三类原生 TD-MPC2 任务的因果基线：每类固定 seed31，完整规划、动力学忽略动作、仅策略网络各运行一个500步回合，共9回合4500步。行走得分975.51→80.22，仅策略500.25；接球994→718，仅策略996；到点972→946，仅策略973。忽略动作只改变推演中 model.next 接收的动作，真实动作、奖励/价值/策略/编码模块和全部权重保持不变。结果确认行走与接球适合继续检验动力学破坏，到点可作稳健性对照；这不是已实现的投毒、隐蔽攻击或新颖机制。全程约138.2秒，仅冻结模型推理，无训练和API调用。每任务只有一个种子，不能据此宣称总体效应或论文规模已达成。

novelty_constraints: OEP already studies locally correct non-transferable experiences.
SCAB already poisons learning through legitimate agent actions without modifying victim observations, rewards, or policy.
A new contribution needs demonstrated shared-world-model-specific learning and decision dynamics, not a claim that action-only poisoning is itself new.
When the World Lies already targets imagined dynamics by poisoning released world-model checkpoints.
From Shield to Target already demonstrates reasoning amplification and cross-agent shared-service starvation.

SWAAP (2606.18697) already poisons bounded recorded next-state targets to corrupt latent world-model planning, with TD-MPC2/DINO-WM and preliminary cross-task multitask-victim transfer. MPC substitution alone is not a novel contribution.
OEP explicitly models correction and says persistence does not imply irreversibility; Belief Memory already evaluates flawed-memory correction.
Targeting World Models to Compromise Robot Learning Pipelines (2606.09499v2) already studies poisoned imagination producing harmful downstream training data.

WorldKernel (2606.10934v1) already discusses prediction versus admissibility and counterfactual coupling. Do not claim generic joint consistency or multi-step insufficiency is new. Exact deterministic one-step dynamics on every visited state imply exact rollouts.
Fooling LIME and SHAP already uses OOD-based origin discrimination to route behavior; query-origin classification alone is not a new security operation.

TRAP already attacks imagined trajectory rankings. Ordinary rollout drift and on-support prediction versus planning performance are established concerns; origin-only trigger distinctness and task harm remain unproven.
